'''Destri-series laminate beast armor''' was a model of armor designed by [[Piccatech Ltd.]] to protect animals. The armor was made of the same [[Plastoid/Legends|material]] as [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] and was sold for 8,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
